title: Torin 1 vs DMSO from 'treatment', 4 + 4 Ribo-seq/RNA-seq pairs, 10,301 genes tested
summary: The counts are the authors' own quantification as deposited in GEO, not locus's; locus only joined and tested them.
Torin 1 versus DMSO ('treatment'): 4 Ribo-seq/RNA-seq pairs against 4, 10,301 genes tested of 20,431 counted.

At padj < 0.05, 463 genes are translationally regulated (ΔTE changes while the mRNA does not), 9 are buffered, 36 change transcriptionally with the ribosomes following the mRNA, 6 are intensified and 9,787 are unchanged.
ΔTE falls in 326 genes and rises in 152.
The translationally regulated genes with the smallest ΔTE adjusted p-values are VDAC1, PABPC1, GAPDH, CSDE1, PRPS2, KARS, HIST1H2AG, CCT2.

figures.title: ΔTE
figures.caption: Δ RNA against Δ Ribo (log2 fold change, Torin 1 vs DMSO) for 10,301 genes; 463 translationally regulated, 9 buffered, 36 transcriptional, 6 intensified at padj < 0.05; the dashed line is Δ Ribo = Δ RNA.

warnings: 'genotype/variation' takes 2 values among the chosen libraries (sgLARP1, wild-type); the contrast pools them.
